children: will raise about $2 billion through a primary placement of 21.97 million Hong Kong-listed shares at HK$714 ($91.05) each, a 10% discount to its last closing price on Friday, according to deal terms seen by Reuters.
The company is also marketing 20.14 billion yuan ($3.00 billion) of U.S. dollar-settled, zero-coupon convertible bonds due in 2027, the sheet showed.
